summary: At the supermarket entrance, two flatmates realize their reusable bag is missing. They agree to buy only essentials and calmly check what they have at home, what they need and what they will cook for dinner before going inside.
cliffhanger: Next time they will put the reusable shopping bag by the door before leaving home.
visual_hook: Marta checks her personal handbag at the supermarket entrance and realizes she left the reusable shopping bag at home.
everyday_problem: The shopping bag is missing, so the flatmates agree on a small practical grocery list before entering the store.
practical_resolution: They choose essentials, confirm the quantities they need for dinner and remember to bring the reusable bag next time.
